KTET Result 2026 Out - Check Kerala TET February Session Scorecard at ktet.kerala.gov.in - Complete Details

KTET Result 2026 for the February session has been declared by Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan on September 19, 2026. Candidates who wrote the Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test on August 8 and 9, 2026, for Category 1 (LP), Category 2 (UP), Category 3 (High School), and Category 4 (Specialist) can check and download their scorecard at ktet.kerala.gov.in using Register Number and Date of Birth. Get direct result link, steps to download, required credentials, and FAQs here.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test (KTET)
  • Exam Dates : August 8 and August 9, 2026
  • Result Declaration Date : September 19, 2026

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
